items.title: Beyond Activation: Gaze Invocation with Visible Status for an Embodied AR Assistant in Co-Located Collaboration
items.snippet: Wake words face an inherent trade-off: higher sensitivity reduces missed commands but increases accidental activations. In co-located augmented reality (AR), the system must also determine whether the user is speaking to the assistant or to a nearby person. We introduce a new perspective on this problem: combining gaze-based address with an embodied assistant, visible listening status, and turn management across activation, continued interaction, and release. In our implementation, users look at an assistant anchored in the scene and see activation progress and listening status on its body. Su
items.summary: 新しいARアシスタントの研究では、視線を使った呼びかけと、可視化されたリスニングステータスを組み合わせることで、ユーザーとアシスタントのインタラクションを向上させる方法が提案されているにゃ。これにより、誤動作を減らし、より自然な会話が可能になるそうだにゃん。
